mapper.select: SELECT country_code, app_token, table_id, field_mapping, sync_enabled, seed_version, user_modified, created_at, updated_at FROM feishu_country_config WHERE country_code = #{countryCode}
SELECT country_code FROM feishu_country_config ORDER BY country_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feishu_country_config (country_code, app_token, table_id, field_mapping, sync_enabled, seed_version, user_modified) VALUES (#{countryCode}, #{appToken}, #{tableId}, #{fieldMappingJson}, #{syncEnabled}, #{seedVersion}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE app_token = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), app_token, VALUES(app_token)), table_id = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), table_id, VALUES(table_id)), field_mapping = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), field_mapping, VALUES(field_mapping)), sync_enabled = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), sync_enabled, VALUES(sync_enabled)), seed_version = IF(user_modified = 1 AND seed_version >= VALUES(seed_version), seed_version, VALUES(seed_version)), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO feishu_country_config (country_code, app_token, table_id, field_mapping, sync_enabled, seed_version, user_modified) VALUES (#{countryCode}, #{appToken}, #{tableId}, #{fieldMappingJson}, #{syncEnabled}, #{seedVersion}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE app_token = VALUES(app_token), table_id = VALUES(table_id), field_mapping = VALUES(field_mapping), sync_enabled = VALUES(sync_enabled), seed_version = VALUES(seed_version), user_modified = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
